subject: Urgent: acquirer dispute opened for INV-754 — evidence requested
messages:
From: Novacorp Billing <billing@novacorp.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Failed payment for INV-754 / possible chargeback

Hi Alex,

We received an email from our bank that the payment attempt for invoice INV-754 failed and a dispute/chargeback flow is currently open on their side. The acquirer flagged the transaction with code 4837 (authorization failed after capture) and said they need merchant evidence to avoid full chargeback.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood attempted any retry after the authorization failure?
- If we can provide a signed proof-of-service + original VAT invoice?
- Any transaction id / acquirer reference we should share with our bank?

I've attached the invoice and our internal usage log. We need to get this into Stripe within 48 hours to contest the dispute.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance, Novacorp
[attachment: INV-754.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: usage-report-Nov-2026.csv (csv)]

From: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Novacorp Billing <billing@novacorp.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Failed payment for INV-754 / possible chargeback

Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sending the invoice + usage file. I'm escalating this straight to our payments team (cc'd). Quick summary and next steps from our side:

What happened (summary):
- We received an acquirer-level decline on the authorization for the charge attempt for INV-754 (attempt id ch_3Kabc).
- Stripe performed a fallback capture attempt which resulted in an acquirer response indicating a post-authorization reversal request (acquirer ref acq_89xz). This matches the 4837 note you saw.

What we need to assemble for the dispute:
- Signed invoice (you already attached — good).
- Proof of service/delivery: timestamped API call logs and a usage export showing the features used on the invoice date.
- Customer acceptance evidence: copy of the signed SOW or the subscription order confirmation (we have the order in our system).
- Refund & retry timeline: a short timeline showing we attempted retry and our communication attempts.

Immediate asks for you:
- Can you confirm whether the card on file was a corporate virtual card? If yes, please share the last 4 digits and expiry so we can include the matching instrument data.
- If you have any bank-facing reference from the acquirer (their dispute id), forward it to me and I'll append it to the Stripe evidence packet.

I'll prepare the evidence packet and submit to Stripe within the next 6 hours. Connor — can you pull the API usage log and generate the proof-of-service PDF? Marissa — can you draft the contest letter (short narrative)?

I'll update here once submitted.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Alex.Martinez@redwoodinference.com
[internal]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novacorp.com>

Alex,

Thanks — the card was a corporate virtual card issued by Bankitalia; last4=6789 expiry=09/26 (it was recently expired which may explain the auth failure). The acquirer gave us dispute reference REF-ACQ-20261118-9987 which they asked us to pass to the merchant (I've included it below).

Bank provided this note to us: "Customer claims they did not authorize the transaction; merchant should provide usage logs and signed invoice to contest."

I've attached a screenshot from our issuer and the acquirer reference. We can confirm Novacorp did not request a refund.

Elena

Novacorp / Elena — cc'd Stripe here. We'll keep monitoring and will share Stripe dispute id once it transitions. If Stripe needs any additional merchant fields (acquirer response files, AVS/3DS artifacts), let us know and Connor will pull from the gateway logs.
